name: CPU performance prediction challenge
description: A benchmark dataset and challenge for predicting CPU performance, measuring model accuracy at forecasting CPU metrics across workloads.
evaluation_method: RMSE / MAE (root-mean-square error and mean absolute error); R^2 often reported as a complementary metric
general_score_metric: RMSE (primary), with MAE and R^2 as complementary metrics
reputation: Academic benchmark introduced in 2025 targeting systems researchers; limited adoption outside CPU/microbenchmarking research.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on regression/time-series CPU performance prediction; risk of overfitting to specific workloads/hardware if splits are not workload- or hardware-stratified; dataset size and partitioning materially affect generalization.
